name: list_export_destinations
title: List export destinations
description: List the export destinations registered on this server. Each entry gives the registry name to pass as export_minutes.destination, a human-readable description, and — when the exporter declares one — a JSON Schema (`options_schema`) describing the `options` argument of export_minutes. Read-only, takes no arguments. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: internal.

description.description: What the exporter produces and where.

options_schema.description: JSON Schema for export_minutes.options. Absent when the exporter takes no options.

destinations.name: markdown
destinations.description: Write minutes.md to a local path (defaults to <NARUMI_HOME>/exports/<meeting_id>-v<n>.md).

destinations.name: html
destinations.description: Render minutes as a standalone HTML file.
